## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL with mixed signals; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: shallow breadth (only 4/11 sectors positive) and large-cap dispersion (tech leaders NVDA/META vs MSFT/ORCL/IBM weakness) — major divergence; style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +13.92% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.23% | 1M: +17.93%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +12.64% | 1M: +13.11%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +9.87%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities showing pockets of strength: CEG (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +3.94%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare lagging: LLY (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.72%) BELOW TREND, ABT (1W: -7.18% | 1M: -0.77%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -11.19% | 1M: -8.09%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: PEP (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -5.76%) BELOW TREND, PM (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND. Industrials soft with Boeing notable: BA (1W: -6.29% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: MPC (1W: +13.92% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.23% | 1M: +17.93%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +12.64% | 1M: +13.11%) ABOVE TREND, GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Energy).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: BA (1W: -6.29% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND, PM (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND, PEP (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -5.76%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.72%) BELOW TREND, ABT (1W: -7.18% | 1M: -0.77%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in defensives and select healthcare names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: MPC (1W: +13.92% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.23% | 1M: +17.93%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +12.64% | 1M: +13.11%) ABOVE TREND — energy momentum confirmed. Watch LRCX (1W: +6.12% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY and other 1W/1M divergences; major divergence across several large caps (GOOGL, JNJ, UNH, TTWO) — watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is mixed: NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +7.38% | 1M: +16.40%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +7.43% | 1M: +7.79%) ABOVE TREND versus MSFT (1W: -1.01% | 1M: -1.39%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -9.33% | 1M: -30.26%) BELOW TREND; sector breadth: mixed with clear leadership concentration in a few names.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive: GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +9.87%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +11.59%) ABOVE TREND — breadth tilted positive within the sector and confirming recent earnings/flows.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare pressured overall: LLY (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.72%) BELOW TREND, ABT (1W: -7.18% | 1M: -0.77%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -11.19% | 1M: -8.09%) BELOW TREND while JNJ (1W: -5.01% | 1M: +6.51%) and UNH (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +5.44%) show CORRECTION patterns; sector breadth: weak.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Energy and selective Financials (MPC, VLO, GS, JPM) and monitor Tech leaders (NVDA, META) for confirmation; reduce exposure to lagging defensives and pressured healthcare names. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective given concentrated top performance and major divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PFE (1W: +0.75% | 1M: -7.34%) RECOVERY on FDA approval but price shows 1M weakness (divergence), JPM (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +9.87%) ABOVE TREND on bullish earnings tone, NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND for momentum follow-through. BEARISH: BA (1W: -6.29% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND after 777X delays, UNH (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +5.44%) CORRECTION as DOJ probe headlines add risk, ORCL (1W: -9.33% | 1M: -30.26%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (strong momentum among refiners and producers; sector positive). Financials (earnings/earnings commentary supporting flows). BEARISH: Healthcare (news-driven weakness and earnings/legal headlines) and Consumer Staples (several large names under pressure); Breadth remains 4/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND — confirmation needed via sustained weekly highs to extend gains. AAPL (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +6.50%) ABOVE TREND — failure to hold 1M gains would signal CORRECTION risk. GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND — hold breakout to validate Financials leadership. ORCL (1W: -9.33% | 1M: -30.26%) BELOW TREND — reclaiming 1M losses required to remove downside risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (+85): FDA approval for bladder cancer regimen; price RECOVERY (1W: +0.75% | 1M: -7.34%) — bullish news vs 1M weakness (divergence). LLY (+80): FDA approval for broader cancers; price BELOW TREND (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.72%) — strong catalyst but price not confirming. JPM (+55): upbeat Q2 tone and NII view; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +9.87%) — news confirming strength.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-60): 777X delays and supply snags; price BELOW TREND (1W: -6.29% | 1M: -2.04%) — sentiment confirmed. UNH (-55): DOJ probe expansion; price CORRECTION (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +5.44%) — headline increases downside risk to recent gains. MCD (-55): turnaround concerns; price not in top dataset but headline risk suggests watch for further weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. MPC (1W: +13.92% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.23% | 1M: +17.93%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergences (GOOGL, JNJ, UNH, TTWO pattern flips and ORCL/IBM deep weakness) plus bullish healthcare headlines (PFE/LLY) not yet uniformly confirmed by price — watch for trend breaks.
